title: catpart-fitness history row, schema v0
description: One line of the committed append-only fitness/history.jsonl (ADR-0001): exactly one row per run, accepted or rejected, each recording the corpus digest so a corpus change visibly invalidates comparisons. The scalars carry the per-level L1/L2/L3 ladder (ADR-0001): L1 since Spec C, L2 since ticket #33, L3 still reserved. Evolution is additive within a schema version: consumers must ignore properties they do not know, which is why additionalProperties stays true.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Bumped only by a breaking change of the history-row shape; additive changes keep the version.

inspect_schema_version.description: Version of the catpart-inspect output schema the run validated every parsed file against (1 as of ticket #23); additive field (Spec C: the schema version is part of every output document and every history row). Rows emitted before ticket #23 lack the field.

run_id.description: Run identifier: UTC timestamp (YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ) plus six hex characters, unique per run. Names the full report in fitness/reports/<run_id>.json.

timestamp.description: UTC wall-clock instant of the run, ISO 8601 with a Z suffix.

tool_version.description: catpart-parser package version that produced the row (importlib.metadata; '0+unknown' when the package is not installed).

corpus_digest.description: SHA-256 of the corpus manifest file bytes. The manifest is the corpus registry (per-file SHA-256 digests included), so this binds the run to an exact corpus definition; a different digest voids no-regret comparison against earlier rows (ADR-0001).

accepted.description: Verdict of the run under the no-regret rule (ADR-0001): true for baseline runs and for increments where the Dev split rises and Held-out does not fall; false otherwise.

baseline_run_id.description: run_id of the last accepted row this run was compared against, or null when there is no baseline (first accepted run, or the last accepted row has a different corpus digest).

dev_rose.description: True when a comparable level's Dev rate strictly rose against the baseline (any of L1/L2); null when no baseline comparison happened.

held_out_fell.description: True when a comparable level's Held-out rate fell against the baseline (any of L1/L2); null when no baseline comparison happened.

reason.description: Fixed human-readable verdict string: why the run was accepted or rejected (including the baseline cases).

l2_dev_rose.description: True when the L2 Dev pass rate strictly rose against the baseline; null when no baseline comparison happened or L2 was not comparable (a pre-G5 baseline row carries no L2 scalar). Additive field (ticket #33).

l2_dev_fell.description: True when the L2 Dev pass rate fell against the baseline (a no-regret violation); null when no baseline comparison happened or L2 was not comparable. Additive field (ticket #33).

l2_held_out_fell.description: True when the L2 Held-out pass rate fell against the baseline (a no-regret violation); null when no baseline comparison happened or L2 was not comparable. Additive field (ticket #33).

rate.description: Clean-parse rate on the Dev split: clean / total manifest rows in the split.

clean.description: Files classified clean on the Dev split.

total.description: Manifest rows on the Dev split (the rate's denominator, so missing-on-disk files count as not clean).

rate.description: Clean-parse rate on the Held-out split: clean / total manifest rows in the split.

clean.description: Files classified clean on the Held-out split.

total.description: Manifest rows on the Held-out split.

L2.description: The L2 geometry-sanity scalar (ADR-0001, ticket #33): pass/total over the split's kind=part manifest rows (products excluded - the documented negative, 0/37 sampled products carry any geometry store). Null in rows emitted before G5 and when a split has no part rows (nothing measurable).

rate.description: L2 pass rate on the Dev split: pass / total kind=part manifest rows in the split.

pass.description: Dev part rows whose export passed the L2 sanity gate (export success, non-empty mesh, manifold, finite plausible bounding box, no degenerate triangles above threshold).

total.description: Kind=part manifest rows on the Dev split - the L2 population.

rate.description: L2 pass rate on the Held-out split: pass / total kind=part manifest rows in the split.

pass.description: Held-out part rows whose export passed the L2 sanity gate.

total.description: Kind=part manifest rows on the Held-out split - the L2 population.

L3.description: Reserved for the L3 construct-coverage scalar (ADR-0001); null until that level exists.

report.description: Path of the full run report, relative to the fitness directory: reports/<run_id>.json.
